weapon.d:
Grants Spd+3. During combat, boosts unit's Atk/Spd by number of allies within 2 spaces × 2.
(Maximum bonus of +6 to each stat.)

assist.d: Grants Spd+4 to target ally for 1 turn.
Grants Atk/Spd+3 to target ally for 1 turn.

a.d: If unit is adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Spd+3 during combat.
If unit is adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Spd+4 during combat.
If unit is adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Spd+5 during combat.

b.d: If a Rally Assist skill is used by unit or targets unit, inflicts Spd-3 on foes in cardinal directions of unit through their next actions.
If a Rally Assist skill is used by unit or targets unit, inflicts Spd-5 on foes in cardinal directions of unit through their next actions.
If a Rally Assist skill is used by unit or targets unit, inflicts Spd-7 on foes in cardinal directions of unit through their next actions.
